description:
create_edit_absorb (default true) enables job and proposal creation/editing, manual renumbering, and client/contact merges.

require_job_request_approval (default false) requires approved requests for new projects and subjobs; when false, job claim holders can create projects directly. Proposals are exempt from request approval. Project-value changes on existing jobs require approval in either request-flag state.
Controls time entry and time amendment creation/editing, plus selected timesheet workflow mutations.
Controls purchase order workflow behavior, including second-stage timeout handling and the hidden legacy PO create/update flow.
Enable/Disable notifications for various features. Feature keys are notification_templates codes
